title: Pepper Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and easy pasta bake recipe with a crispy top and a flavorful pepper sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the sliced kooky, gooey, and pepper. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, vegetable mixture, and crumbled norwegian. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with sliced gooey.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Optional: Add some extra gooey on top for an extra-cheesy bake.
